name: Technical University of Denmark
description:
DTU - Technical University of Denmark

Technical University of Denmark, DTU, offers education, research, research based consultancy and innovation in a wide range of technical disciplines. The university's main activities are anchored in 19 departments, a national laboratory for renewable energy and several other university units.

The university owns several experimental facilities, including a number of testing facilities for wind turbines, an ocean-going research vessel, as well as state-of-the-art infrastructure in areas such as cleanroom and nanoscopy. The university has about 5,000 employees of which more than half are researchers, including 1,100 PhD students.

DTU holds a strong position within research and education in the Arctic.  The coordination, strengthening and promotion of the Arctic activies of DTU are anchored in the centre Arctic DTU aiming at:
* strenghening  and utilizing natural science and technical science for the benefit of a sustainable development of nature and society in the Arctic region.
* strenghening the cooperation between DTU and Greenland in the field of arctic related education, innovation and research
* Promoting cooperation between DTU and national and international reseach institutions, authorities and businesses on Arctic issues.

In addition to this Arctic DTU operates the technical campus in Sisimiut - Arctic DTU Sisimiut - Ilinniarfeqarfik Sisimiut in close cooperation with the Government of Greenland and KTI, the technical vocational school of Greenland. The campus conducts education in arctic engineering and research and innovation projects in Arctic technology.
